tailRisk.title: VaR and Expected Shortfall under a fat-tailed distribution
tailRisk.chartLabel: Return densities, normal and Student's t, with VaR and ES at {level}
tailRisk.axis: Return, in standard deviations (losses to the left)
tailRisk.reading95: At 95%, the fat-tailed distribution's VaR is even lower than the normal's, but ES, which looks at the whole tail, is already higher.
tailRisk.reading99: At 99%, the t's VaR and ES both sit above the normal's, and the gap between the two widens for the t.
tailRisk.caption: Illustrative figure made for the site, not the column's data: both distributions have variance 1; values are losses in standard deviations.
